## Progress
- `hh-hir/src/tools.rs` (new, ~710 lines) — the shared tools vocabulary
  (CC7): `ScopeKind` (the closed eight-member sum), `ScopeBinding`,
  `scope_bindings` parsing + scope matching, `SurfaceArgMap` evaluation
  (unmapped ⇒ `UnmappedArgument`; scope-bearing param without binding ⇒
  `UnscopedParameter`; `scope_bindings_unknown` ⇒ `*`-only coverage), the
  run-time `ExposureMode` sum, `AuthoredExposure` (`ToolSurface.
  exposure_mode` parse — OQ-240 interim), `is_discovery_capability`, the
  `discover_surfaces` input schema, `param_path ∈ input_schema`, and the
  record-local V-E1 battery `validate_capability(rec, authority)`
  (checks 1/3/4/7/8 + resources tri-state; authority is the node's
  provenance — conferred, never read from content, CC2).
- `hh-hir/src/schema.rs` — the semantic projection drops `exposure_hint`
  and `cost_model.measured_ref` (V-E1-9; the `cost_model` member itself
  stays semantic); both remain in the version basis.
- `hh-hir/src/validate.rs` — `check_kind_record` runs `validate_capability`;
  `check_discovery_capability` is the document-level I-DISCOVERY half
  (admits `deferred`/`indexed` without a `discover_surfaces` capability ⇒
  `NoDiscoverySurface` — AC-R-2.5.3-2's static half).
- `hh-hir/src/risk.rs` — `capability_risk`: absent attributes ⇒
  `RiskClass::UNKNOWN`; `read_only` mutability forces `read_only`
  reversibility; `world` maps to scope; `unverified` ⇒ the most dangerous
  class (CF-104/ADR-0031).
- `hh-hir/src/errors.rs` — `EmptyEffectSet`, `UnscopedParameter`,
  `UnmappedParameter`, `LiftedDeclarationsNotUnverified`,
  `ExactCostUnmeasured`, `NoDiscoverySurface`;
  `hh-assembly/src/diagnostics.rs` mirrors them.
- `hh-monitor/src/args.rs` — reduced to re-exports of the HIR-owned
  vocabulary (one schema source; the runtime-facing wrappers stay).
- `hh-identity/src/kinds.rs` — `RecordKind::ToolSurface` + the
  `tool_surface` domain tag (`surface_id` domain separation).
- `hh-registry` — `CapabilityRecord{node}` (`RegistryRecord::Capability`;
  schema encode/decode; stage-1 kind support); `register` runs V-E1
  (`CapabilityValidation`) + admission (lifted/`unknown_domain` ⇒
  `quarantined` — CF-210) and emits `lifecycle.capability.registered`;
  `lookup` is the raw read (`Audit` projection — quarantined records are
  inspectable; `resolve` stays the governed path); `capability.rs` —
  `capability_at`, `project_risk`, `required_grants` (the V-EFF view),
  `estimate` (every `DimensionId` present, undeclared ⇒ `unknown`, never
  0), `catalog`, `search_projection` — all derived, never stored.
- `hh-env/src/executor.rs` — `bind_capability` checks the
  `execution_requirement` against the `ExecutorDeclaration` (isolation,
  dedup, interrupt support); a `pure` capability needs no domain coverage
  (the earlier `ModelCall`-coverage requirement on `pure` was a bug —
  fixed).
- `hh-compiler/src/surface.rs` (new) — `CompileExposureMode` (the §5d.2
  sum — distinct from the run-time `ExposureMode`, ADR-0252 §1),
  `BindingMapping` (`surface_arg_map` | `plan_map` — declared, `plan_map`
  refused at C0 compile), the `SurfaceFailure` closed sum +
  `SurfaceRejected` payload (`action.tool.surface_rejected` shape),
  `ResultRenderSpec{full|truncate{max_lines,max_bytes,max_tokens,
  direction}}`, `ErrorFormatSpec` + `check_distinguishable` (the C0 E5
  half), `surface_id` (`idp("tool_surface", …)` over the surface members —
  self-verifying on decode).
- `hh-compiler/src/equiv.rs` — `SurfaceBinding` extended additively with
  the full §5d.2 member set (`surface_id`, `exposure_mode`,
  `capability_refs`, `mapping`, `rule_ids`, `evidence_ref`, `safety_ref`,
  `effects_bound`, `family_id`, `variant_id`, `admitted_modes`, `pinned`,
  `hidden`); `bind_surface` mints `surface_id` and populates
  `effects_bound`/`capability_refs` from the capability.
- `hh-compiler/src/schema.rs` — the binding codec covers every member;
  absent members decode with C0 defaults (CC8 — pre-S1.17 bundles still
  load); a *present* `surface_id` must re-mint equal.
- `hh-compiler/src/exposure.rs` (new) — `CatalogEntry`/`Catalog`/
  `SourceState`/`IndexForm`/`IndexGranularity`/`SearchTextField`/
  `PermissionCoverage`/`Availability`, `CatalogDelta`/`CatalogEpoch`,
  `ExposurePolicyParams` + the `ExposurePolicy` trait, `TurnState`,
  `ExposurePlan`/`RevealedSet`/`RevealCause`/`Retention`/`EvictCause`/
  `DriftPolicy`/`PermissionGate`/`DiscoveryExecutorPreference`, the
  `DiscoveryQuery`/`DiscoveryResult`/`CatalogIndex{ExactName,
  StaticAllowlist}` machinery, `build_catalog`, `select_surfaces` (the
  `admit → rank → enforce` kernel pipeline with `direct_all`),
  `check_callable` + `CallRefusal::{SurfaceNotRevealed,
  SurfaceUnavailable}`, `reveal`/`evict`, `index_ref`/`index_query`,
  `catalog_id`/`plan_id` (all content-addressed).
- `hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` — `lifecycle.capability.registered`
  (audit-grade, `REGISTRY_FIELDS`) + the seven OQ-235 exposure rows
  (`action.tool.{exposure.planned, discovery.searched, surface.evicted,
  call.refused, catalog.built, catalog.delta, catalog.epoch}` —
  `kernel_origin` `ledger`; `call.refused` closes `ToolCall`).
- `hh-telemetry/src/catalogue.rs` — `surface_rejection_rate` (native,
  `{events, ledger}`, `surface_rejected ÷ proposed`, ppm; computation is
  C0/S3 → `NotComputed`) + the ADR-0094 D6 exposure family declarations.
